extended:
**An Extension of the Character Ring of sl(3) and Its Quantisation P. Furlan∗,†**

*A.Ch. Ganchev∗∗*

40 pp, 10 sections.

**Abstract.** We construct a commutative ring with identity which extends the ring of characters of ﬁnite dimensional representations of sl(3). It is generated by characters with values in the group ring Z[ ˜W] of the extended aﬃne Weyl group of bsl(3)k at k̸ ∈Q. The ‘quantised’ version at rational level k + 3 = 3/p realises the fusion rules of a WZW conformal ﬁeld theory based on admissible representations of bsl(3)k . furlan@ts.infn.it, ganchev@inrne.bas.bg, petkova@ts.infn.it 1

**Outline.** Front matter; Abstract; 1 Introduction; 2 Preliminaries.; 3 Characters.; 4 Character ring and its structure constants; 6 Quantised ‘q’-characters; 7 Pasquier–Verlinde type formula; Acknowledgements; References
